title: Boss test for my deck builder
author: LatentBlade
selftext: I've been using my boss to debug some things and I like the way his combos hit. I think it highlights that while my game is inspired by the Slay The Spire, it is not a direct clone. One of the big differences is that the opponent uses a deck and can link combos the same way you can. I didn't try to defend here and this isn't a fair fight for debugging purposes, but you get the idea of how combos can chain (especially when you have stun cards). I almost have my debugging done for now and will move onto using Omni to make better animations soon.

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: Thanks. I'm glad you like the new version.
